selection.selection_rule: all tasks assigned to community_45 at the pinned revision
rationale: Use a complete community instead of cherry-picking questions.
Use a domain not covered by the registered community_43 and community_52 operators.
Keep the archive small enough for repeatable local and CI evaluation.
metadata_known_at_selection: dataset labels indicating an IPL match-data domain

blinding.attestation: No community_45 question text, answer guideline, oracle, reference program, archive member list, schema, or data row was inspected before this selection was frozen.
permitted_before_implementation_freeze: verify its byte size and SHA-256 digest
develop against non-held-out examples and synthetic fixtures

Pre-unblinding evidence-chain hardening: freeze the static task/path/model plan and the redaction guard; verify the exact extracted-data census before model construction; atomically transition sealed/scored states; and exercise tamper, partial-run, recovery, and duplicate-scoring paths on synthetic fixtures. No held-out payload was inspected.

Pre-unblinding paper-aligned observability: add asynchronously persisted Discovery hops, DeepPrep operator candidate traces, and safe compiled DeepAnalyze-style analysis notebook cells with focused and full regression tests. No community_45 payload was inspected.

Pre-unblinding stage input/output schemas and bounded prepared-table previews; same-provider structured report synthesis, artifact-reference validation, and the development-smoke evidence-packet correction. The 158-test backend suite passed; no held-out extraction, question, or run artifact exists, and no community_45 payload was inspected.
